units.title: Introduction to Electric and Hybrid Vehicles
topics: 1.1. Evolution and significance of EVs in sustainable transportation.
1.2. Indian Policies and subsidies, on adoption of Electric Vehicle.
1.3. Benefits of EVs in terms of emissions, energy efficiency, and renewable integration.
1.4. Types of HEVs; Mild HEV, Full HEV, Plug in HEV, Series HEV, Parallel HEV, Series – Parallel HEV
1.5. Comparative analysis: EVs vs. HEVs vs. conventional vehicles.
1.6. Classification of hybrid powertrains into series, parallel configurations
1.7. Analyze the lifecycle emissions of EVs
uos: 1.a. Evolution, significance, and market trends of EVs and HEVs
1.b. Overview of FAME Scheme and its impact on EV adoption.
1.c. Comparison of EVs, HEVs, and conventional vehicles in energy efficiency and emissions.
1.d. Distinguish between the different types of hybrid powertrains.
1.e. Illustrate the environmental lifecycle of EVs, focusing on emissions and battery recycling.

units.title: Electric Vehicle Powertrain Components
topics: 2.1. Electric Motors in EV and HEVs; Construction and working of Brushless DC Motor (BLDC), Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) and Induction Motors.
2.2. Motors Performance characteristics and selection criteria for electric vehicle applications.
2.3. Importance of inverters in EV systems.
2.4. Role of converters in EV systems.
2.5. Overview of motor control strategies and importance of efficiency in drives.
2.6. Simplified transmission systems in EVs and HEVs.
2.7. Role and importance of direct-drive systems.
uos: 2.a. Identify different types of motors used in EV applications
2.b. Explain the role, Functions, and working of electric motors in EV and HEV.
2.c. Compare and Analyze the performance characteristics and selection criteria of various motor types for EV applications.
2.d. Role and functions of inverters, converters, and direct-drive systems in EV powertrains.

units.title: Battery Technology and Battery Management Systems (BMS)
topics: 3.1. Types of Battery and its comparative analysis.
3.2. Battery Management System (BMS); Functions
3.3. State of Charge and State of Health and enlist their estimation methods
3.4. Importance of temperature control in battery life and safety.
3.5. Cooling strategies: Air, liquid, and phase-change material (PCM) cooling.
3.6. Charging levels (AC Level 1, AC Level 2, DC fast charging).
3.7. Wireless charging technology and recent advancements.
uos: 3.a. Identify Types of EV batteries, their properties, and sustainability aspects.
3.b. Functions of Battery Management Systems (BMS), including SOC and SOH estimation.
3.c. Importance of thermal management and comparison of charging technologies.
